pages.text: This is a $(l:programming/conditions)Condition/$ widget.$(p)The $(thing)Condition: Dimension/$ widget allows you to check the drone's current dimension. Presence of this widget in your drone program is $(o)required/$ to allow programmable drones to change dimensions, e.g. by going through a Nether portal.

You can filter the dimension to be checked for with a $(l:programming/text)Text/$ widget containing the dimension ID to check for, e.g. $(thing)minecraft:overworld/$ or $(thing)minecraft:the_nether/$. Text widgets on the right act as a whitelist, text widgets on the left act as a blacklist.
